- **M17 (Product-deactivated)**: The reaction will stall almost immediately. The high initial [P]0 (0.5) will rapidly drive the `catS` intermediate into the inactive `catSP` state, killing the catalyst before the already low amount of substrate can be consumed.
- **M12 (Product-deactivated cat)**: Similar to M17, the reaction will stall early due to the high initial [P]0 directly deactivating the free catalyst.
